seams.why: Adds hubAuthPlugin to Better Auth's plugins: the registration gate.
The auth package calls the Hub's access rules.
The web app calls the Hub's services from its API routes.
Renders the Hub's sign-in page instead of Kan's view.
Renders the invite-only notice instead of Kan's sign-up form.
Shows the Hub's product name, swaps Kan's project menu for HubSidebarTop, hides links the person has no permission for, and adds the back-office link.
The API package hosts the Hub's tRPC router and guards, and exports the Hub's MCP tools (./hub-mcp) to the web app.
Mounts the Hub's back-office router at api.hub.
Only back-office admins may create projects (workspaces); search passes a condition that leaves out other people's 仅自己可见 boards and their cards.
Search takes an optional extra board condition, so hidden boards are left out before its limits apply, not after.
Only project admins may create templates; a project's board list leaves out other people's 仅自己可见 boards; a board page leaves out the cards in 归档.
The two board queries take an optional list of cards to leave out, so cards in 归档 never reach a board page.
Every procedure first refuses requests that name anything inside someone else's 仅自己可见 board; the logging middleware leaves the caller and input out of anonymous procedures' entries (催一下).
Kan's router tests use stand-in databases; a setup file lets them skip the private-board guard.
Someone with no project yet goes to the home page, which explains the wait, instead of being asked to create a project.
switchWorkspace takes an optional redirect, so the home page can switch projects without being sent to /boards.
Makes the hidden attribute win over display utilities, which is how the Hub hides actions people have no permission for.
Create and import buttons only for people allowed to create; on the templates page only for project admins.
Shows the project's 总版 tile first; the empty list's create button follows the same permission rule as the page's.
"Make template" only for project admins.
Hides an action the person has no permission for instead of showing it disabled.
Hides an action the person has no permission for instead of showing it disabled; renders the Hub's visibility menu, which adds 仅自己可见.
Adds the Hub's rewrites: MCP clients fetch the OAuth discovery documents from /.well-known on the site's origin, and the pages router only serves API routes under /api.
Raises the unit-test job's time limit from 15 to 25 minutes: the Hub's integration tests boot an in-memory database each, and the suite already took 13-14 minutes.
Regenerated by pnpm whenever a dependency changes.
